{{Quote|The first savorium-fed thookahs have already proven effective, as a Krozurbian War Council, fed on thookah-steaks, has turned away from two centuries of war and embraced peace.|[[PDA6]] describes the effect of savorium on the Krozurbians|<ref name="SOR4" />}}
[[File:Krozurbian_War_Council.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Krozurbian War Council embraces peace after eating savorium-fed thookah-steaks]]
'''Thookah-steaks''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] made from [[thookah]]s and a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]]. Thookah-steaks made from thookahs that had been fed [[Savorium herb|savorium]] by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Zorneth]] ultimately caused the [[Krozurbian War Council]] to end a 200-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] war, as these steaks produced the same pacifistic euphoria in their consumers as occurred in those who consumed savorium directly.<ref name="SOR4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thookah-steaks were mentioned in [[Jan Strnad]]'s [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids (1995)'' 8]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[1995]].<ref name="SOR4" />
